FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Arizona fishing licence

Residents and visitors aged 10 or older need a licence for publicly accessible waters. Children aged 10 to 17 need the youth licence.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and non-residents aged 10 or older in publicly accessible water.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 10.
  • Blind Arizona residents.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident general fishingnon resident365 days$55 USD
Youth combination, ages 10–17any365 days$5 USD
Non-resident short-term combinationnon residentPer selected day$20 USD

Rules visitors should know

  • Annual licences last 365 days.
  • Purchased licences cannot be exchanged or refunded.

How to buy

Use the online purchase links on the department's fishing licence page.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Arizona?

Residents and visitors aged 10 or older need a licence for publicly accessible waters. Children aged 10 to 17 need the youth licence.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Arizona?

Non-resident general fishing: $55 USD; Youth combination, ages 10–17: $5 USD; Non-resident short-term combination: $20 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Arizona?

Use the online purchase links on the department's fishing licence page.
